# Nature Skills attribution

Source: https://github.com/Yuan1z0825/nature-skills

Pinned commit: c6ae86c742705fd968b13c79db1a8518a84089d4

Maintainer: Yuan1z0825 and the upstream contributors identified in the individual skills.

This repository does not include the upstream files. `scripts/install-nature-skills.py` downloads the pinned commit and installs the complete skills directory under `.agents/skills/nature-*`, checking every file against `docs/nature-skills-installation.json`. The upstream files are unchanged. The project adds task routing in AGENTS.md and adapts its existing paper skill to consult the library. Main upstream license: Apache License 2.0, copied alongside this notice. Individual skill and third-party material notices remain in their original directories.
